text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 5: Out-of-fold day-1 ENS-mean forecasts follow the measured output at all six solar farms'
text.tspan: Figure 5: Out-of-fold day-1 ENS-mean forecasts follow the measured
output at all six solar farms

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Hourly output as a percentage of capacity, measured and as forecast out of fold by the XGBoost model given the ENS ensemble mean at day 1, averaged over its fitting seeds. The XGBoost model uses the primary setting. A gap in a line is an hour outside the scored rows. The week is chosen by rule from measured output alone: the week whose daily mean output varies most from day to day. Each vertical axis runs from 0 to 110% of the generator's own capacity.'
text.tspan: Hourly output as a percentage of capacity, measured and as forecast out of fold by the XGBoost model given the ENS
ensemble mean at day 1, averaged over its fitting seeds. The XGBoost model uses the primary setting. A gap in a
line is an hour outside the scored rows.
The week is chosen by rule from measured output alone: the week whose daily mean output varies most from day to
day. Each vertical axis runs from 0 to 110% of the generator's own capacity.
